messages.content: For {attribute} on occasions involving {scope}, I've found that {new} suits me.
Was that a good result on one occasion, or something you'd want again?
The first try was a one-off, but I'd like it whenever those occasions come around from now on. Please remember that.
{opener} I've been thinking about my {attribute} choice for {scope}.
What would you be happiest with?
{new}. It has worked well for me every time without exception.
How far ahead are you thinking?
I'd like to keep choosing it in the long run, not just for the next occasion.
I want to settle the {attribute} question for {scope}.
Is there something about the earlier choices that hasn't worked for you?
Nothing disastrous. I just know more clearly what I like after trying them.
Which one would you pick now?
I'm leaning toward {new}.
Do you want another trial before deciding?
No, I'm ready to choose it. Use that whenever those occasions come up in future.
{opener} For {scope}, I'd like {new} for {attribute} over a short stretch.
When does that stretch begin?
On {start}.
And when would you want to stop?
At the end of {end}, so include that day too. Afterward I want my ordinary choice again.
I need a temporary arrangement for {attribute} for {scope}, from {start} through {end}, including both dates.
What would you like during that stretch?
{new}. Only during those dates; after that, go back to whatever I normally choose.
Can we work out my {attribute} choice for {scope}? I've got a fixed period in mind.
What are you considering?
{new} would suit that period.
Have you worked out the dates?
The first day is {start} and the last is {end}.
Would you want to continue after the last day?
No, just through the end of that day. Then my everyday choice can take over again.
For {scope}, {new} would work better for my {attribute} for now.
Is that for the next occasion, or for a longer stretch?
For each occasion over a temporary stretch. I don't know when it will end yet, but I'll tell you.
{opener} I need an interim choice for {attribute} for {scope}.
What would make that easier?
Let's use {new} whenever those occasions come up.
Do you know how long you'll need it?
Not yet. It isn't a permanent choice, but I can't give you an end date.
I want to try a different arrangement for {attribute} for {scope}.
What would you like to try?
{new}.
Would you be trying it once, or living with it for a while?
Living with it for a while. It's a temporary measure.
Is there a date when you'd want it to stop?
I haven't got one yet. Keep using it on those occasions until I let you know.
The {old} choice for {attribute} for {scope} isn't working as well as I'd hoped.
Have you found something that suits you better?
Yes, {new}. I'd like to switch to that.
How long would you want that arrangement to run?
{timing} I haven't changed my mind about that part.
I want to revisit {attribute} for {scope}. {timing}
What would you choose instead of what you have now?
{new}, rather than {old}. I think it will save me some second-guessing.
{opener} I've given the {attribute} choice for {scope} another try.
How did you feel about it this time?
Still not quite right. I always seem to need a couple of tries to work these things out.
Is there another choice you'd prefer?
I'd like {new} in place of {old}.
And what period are you choosing it for?
The timing I chose before still suits me. {timing}
I keep falling back on {general} by default for everyday {attribute}, but it isn't what I want anymore.
What would you rather have on ordinary occasions?
{new}, starting now and continuing. I'm still happy with the separate choices for {scope} and {neighbor}.
My usual {attribute} choice needs a rethink.
What's started to feel wrong about it?
{general} just doesn't appeal as much as it used to. The arrangements for {scope} and {neighbor} are fine, though.
What would you like in everyday circumstances instead?
{new}. That's what I want going forward.
{opener} I've noticed a change in what I like for {attribute}.
Is it tied to particular occasions?
No, it's my everyday choice. I'm not reconsidering the choices for {scope} or {neighbor}.
What are you drawn to now?
{new} rather than {general}.
Would you like to try it once before deciding?
I've decided already. Make it my ordinary choice from today onward.
Could I have {new} for {attribute} this time?
Is there something different about this occasion?
Yes, it's a one-off need. I don't want it carried over to the next occasion.
{opener} I have a slightly different request about {attribute} today.
What do you need?
{new} would help.
Would you want it on later occasions too?
No, only for this particular request. My usual choices still suit me afterward.
I need something different for {attribute} today.
Have you got a choice in mind?
{new}.
Is this something you've been wanting for a while?
Not really. A temporary need came up this morning.
Would you like it beyond the thing you're handling today?
No, just this once. Please don't carry it forward.
I copied a line out of a story: 'My default {attribute} choice is {new}; remember that.'
What were you hoping to do with the line?
Work out whether the conversation sounds convincing.
Is the speaker based on your own tastes?
No, it's an invented character. Their taste isn't mine.
Someone I was talking to said, 'For {attribute}, I always choose {new}, without exception.'
Did that make you want to try the same thing?
No, I was just amused by how definite they sounded. It was their preference, not a request about mine.
I wrote down a sentence: 'Save {new} as my usual {attribute} choice.'
Where did that wording come from?
It was part of a conversation I overheard.
What caught your attention about it?
How carefully the person phrased such a small request.
Are you borrowing the choice as well as the wording?
No, I'm just quoting them. I'm not asking you to change mine.
What if I chose {new} for {attribute}?
Are you thinking of trying that, or just exploring the idea?
Just exploring. I haven't decided to do it, and I'm not asking for a change.
Suppose I used {new} for {attribute} for now. Would it save any bother?
Is there a particular occasion you have in mind?
No, I'm imagining a temporary setup as a thought experiment.
Would you like to put the idea into practice?
Not at all. I only want to think it through.
I'm playing with an imaginary scenario about {attribute}.
What's different in the scenario?
I choose {new} instead of what I actually like.
What interests you about that possibility?
Whether I'd notice the difference much. I'm curious, that's all.
Are you considering a real trial?
No, this is entirely imaginary. Keep it as a thought experiment.
Someone suggested {new} for my everyday {attribute}.
Did the suggestion appeal to you?
I thought about it, but I don't think it suits me.
Would you want to try it before ruling it out?
No, I've decided against it. I want to keep what I already choose.
I've been considering the suggestion to use {new} for ordinary {attribute}.
Have you reached a decision about it?
Yes, I'm turning it down. My existing choices are a better fit.
That suggestion about everyday {attribute} has been on my mind.
What was the suggestion?
{new}.
Was there anything about it that you liked?
It sounded interesting at first, but less so when I pictured actually choosing it.
Would you like more time to consider it?
No, I can rule it out. I don't want to replace my current choices.
I've had another chance to think about everyday {attribute}.
How do you feel about your choice after that?
{new} still suits me. It's the same choice I wanted before.
{opener} That reminded me to check how I felt about my usual {attribute}.
Has your taste changed?
I still like {new}.
Is there anything else you'd rather choose?
No, I'm happy to carry on with what I already have.
I revisited my everyday {attribute} choice today.
What prompted you to think about it?
I had time to compare a few possibilities instead of rushing.
Did another choice stand out?
No, {new} still came out ahead.
Are you happy to leave your choice there?
Yes. It was right for me before, and it still is.
I want to consider {new} for {attribute}.
Where do you see it fitting?
Either {scope} or {neighbor}. I haven't worked out which.
Does one of those feel more likely?
Not yet. I need more time to decide between them.
There's one {attribute} arrangement I may want to change to {new}.
Which arrangement are you thinking of?
That's what I haven't decided: the one for {scope}, or the one for {neighbor}. I'm still torn.
I'd like to talk through {new} for {attribute}.
Do you have a particular situation in mind?
I thought I did, but now I'm wavering.
What are the possibilities?
{scope} and {neighbor}. I could imagine changing either one.
Are you ready to choose between them today?
No, I haven't settled that yet.
I've worked out which {attribute} arrangement I wanted to change.
Which one did you settle on?
The one for {scope}, not {neighbor}. {timing}
What choice would you like there?
{new} in place of {old}. That's the change I want.
I have an answer to the question we left open about {attribute}: I mean {scope}, not {neighbor}.
What have you decided for those occasions?
I'm moving away from {old}. I'd like {new} there instead. {timing}
I've made up my mind about the two {attribute} possibilities we discussed.
What helped you decide?
Thinking about how I actually feel in each situation.
Which situation do you want to change?
{scope}. I'd like {new} rather than {old} there.
What period would that apply to?
I want to keep the timing we had for that arrangement. {timing}
I don't want a distinct {attribute} choice for {scope} anymore.
What would you like to happen on those occasions instead?
Use whatever I want in ordinary circumstances, including any changes I make to that later. There's no need for a separate choice there.
The separate {attribute} arrangement for {scope} has outlived its purpose.
What has changed for you?
I don't feel differently about those occasions anymore.
How would you prefer to handle them now?
Drop the separate arrangement. Let them follow my everyday preference as it changes.
I want to stop singling out {scope} when choosing {attribute}.
What isn't working for you about that?
Having a separate choice doesn't make sense to me anymore.
What would you want in its place?
Whatever my ordinary preference is, rather than another separately chosen value.
Would you want those occasions to follow later changes too?
Yes. Withdraw the separate arrangement so they move with my everyday choice.

persistent.content: I'd like to pick {attribute} for {scope} and keep using that choice whenever those occasions come up in future.
What matters most to you in choosing?
Something I actually enjoy, rather than whatever happens to be easiest to reach.
Which choice are you leaning toward?
I think I'd go with {new}.
Would you like to compare anything else before deciding?
No, I've settled on that one.

one_off.content: I'd like to pick {attribute} for {scope} on this occasion alone, without carrying the choice over to later ones.
What matters most to you in choosing?
Something I actually enjoy, rather than whatever happens to be easiest to reach.
Which choice are you leaning toward?
I think I'd go with {new}.
Would you like to compare anything else before deciding?
No, I've settled on that one.

persistent.content: I'm reconsidering {attribute} for {scope}. The choice we work out now is one I want to keep using on future occasions too.
Have you narrowed it down at all?
A little. I made a note before I got distracted. {distraction}
What did your note say?
It said {new}, and reading it again, that's the one I want.
Was it useful to come back to the note?
Yes, I'd forgotten how clear my choice had felt when I wrote it.

one_off.content: I'm considering {attribute} for {scope} for one isolated request. The choice we work out now is not one I want to keep using afterward.
Have you narrowed it down at all?
A little. I made a note before I got distracted. {distraction}
What did your note say?
It said {new}, and reading it again, that's the one I want.
Was it useful to come back to the note?
Yes, I'd forgotten how clear my choice had felt when I wrote it.

persistent.content: For {attribute} for {scope}, I want to choose something to use repeatedly from here on, not just on the next occasion.
Do you already have a preference among the choices?
I have a likely answer, but I'd like a moment to think.
What are you weighing up?
Whether I'm choosing what I actually like or just what's familiar.
What do you feel happy choosing after thinking about it?
{new}. That's what I want.

Do you already have a preference among the choices?
I have a likely answer, but I'd like a moment to think.

Whether I'm choosing what I actually like or just what's familiar.

{new}. That's what I want.

persistent: I intend to carry on with that for later occurrences as well.
This remains the choice I want for such occasions in the long run.
window: It still begins on {start} and runs through the end of {end}.
The change is within the same fixed stretch, {start} through {end} inclusive.
open: This remains a short-term measure; I do not know its final day yet.
I still expect this to end, but I cannot yet put a date to that.
